Answer only from these help center sections, and cite the article title.

Source: Fees and courtesy reversals > Courtesy reversals
As a courtesy, Tidewell Bank can reverse one overdraft or NSF fee every 12 months (365 days). To be eligible, the fee must have been charged within the last 90 days. You can request a courtesy reversal in chat after verifying your identity.

Source: Overdraft and NSF fees explained > Getting an overdraft or NSF fee refunded
Eligible overdraft and NSF fees can be refunded through a courtesy reversal, available once every 12 months for fees charged within the last 90 days. See "Fees and courtesy reversals."

Source: Fees and courtesy reversals > Fees that aren't eligible for a courtesy reversal
Wire transfer fees and monthly account fees aren't eligible for courtesy reversals. Overdraft and NSF fees charged more than 90 days ago also aren't eligible.

Source: Fees and courtesy reversals > What happens when a fee is reversed
A reversed fee is credited back immediately to the account it was charged to. You receive a reference number starting with FR, and the refund appears in your transactions as a separate credit, such as "Overdraft Fee Reversal." The original fee also stays in your transaction history.

Source: Disputing a transaction > Fees can't be disputed
Fees, such as overdraft or NSF fees, can't be disputed. Eligible overdraft and NSF fees can be refunded through a courtesy reversal instead. See "Fees and courtesy reversals."
